description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Animal companion or mount class feature, character level 7th, galka or roegadyn

Benefit: Select one of the following creature types: elephant, pteranodon, rhinoceros, stegosaurus, or triceratops. Add this creature type to your list of possible animal companions or mounts. When summoning a creature of the selected type to serve as a mount or companion, treat your effective beastmaster level as if it were two levels higher (to a maximum of your character level). If the creature is large enough for you to ride, it gains the combat training general purpose (see Handle Animal) at no cost.

system.requirements: Animal companion or mount class feature, character level 7th, galka or roegadyn
